title: xebench published sessions
description: Every session published from an evidence bundle per board row key, which one data/benchmarks.json displays, and every measured row that left the board. A key's displayed session is chosen only from its sessions in the engine's displayed measurement set (configs/board.json engines: configuration and backend, engine and binding version, measured from a date): the newest verified, else the newest unverified (newest = latest timestampIso, then sessionId). A failed session is never displayed; a retired key (configs/board.json retiredKeys) displays nothing. Each session keeps the full row it publishes, so the row a key displays is reproducible from this file. replacedRows keeps every row without a session that left data/benchmarks.json: replaced by a session (replace-legacy, replace-failed) or retired (with the reason). Schema 1.0 files (selection by configuration only) are read for migration; the producer writes 1.1. Invariants this schema cannot express (key order, row identity, the selection, agreement with data/benchmarks.json and configs/board.json) are enforced by scripts/lib/history.mjs and scripts/lib/sets.mjs.

schemaVersion.description: 1.1 since measurement sets; 1.0 is read only to migrate

displayed.description: sessionId of the session data/benchmarks.json shows for this key; null when it shows none (retired, or no session in the engine's set)

sessions.description: oldest first; empty for a key whose only history is a retired row

row.description: the data/benchmarks.json row this session publishes (validated against its row schema)

replacedBy.description: replace-legacy and replace-failed: the session that replaced the row

note.description: retired: the reason from configs/board.json retiredKeys

retiredAt.description: retired: the date from configs/board.json retiredKeys

row.description: the row data/benchmarks.json showed before, byte for byte as JSON
